list: Official PlayStation 5 list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Platinum requires the other 54 trophies. Use the checklist to find every remaining requirement; the list gives no shortcut or unlock order. Route details can be added after release.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the named opening mission, Gone Fishing. The trophy list does not describe its objectives or route; follow the in-game mission markers. No missable condition is stated.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1. The public list does not identify its mission steps or replay rules, so use the chapter objective shown in game; details can be confirmed after release.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Its trophy text gives the chapter but no mission route or cutoff; follow the in-game story marker. No irreversible missable is specified.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 using the story progression shown in game. The list names the chapter only, so it does not support a more detailed route yet.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 from the story progression. The official wording gives no objectives or missable window; check the in-game chapter prompt.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. The trophy text does not name it or describe prerequisites; follow the story to its ending and confirm any choice requirements in game after release.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete Breakfast Run. Start it when its mission marker becomes available; the list does not state where that marker appears or whether replay is possible.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist. The list supplies the mission name but no route or preparation requirements; use the in-game mission briefing.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete Child’s Play. Follow its in-game mission marker; the trophy list does not publish steps or a missable deadline.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners. The list names the mission but not its location or objectives, so use the in-game briefing for the route.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. Follow the named mission through its objectives; no additional conditions are given in the published trophy text.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete Operation Savage Glory. Its mission title is the only route detail in the list; follow the on-screen briefing when available.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Raise the game’s completion tracker to 100%. The list does not enumerate the activities that count, so use the in-game completion breakdown to find remaining work.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. The list does not name stunt types or locations; track the counter in game and continue until it records 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type. The published description does not provide the type list or a count; sample each activity the game presents and check for the unlock.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge. The list gives no challenge names or scoring advice; replay any short of gold and use its in-game medal target.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. The description does not list locations or their order; keep a location checklist as they become available.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeat wins on the same race do not meet the wording, so choose distinct race events and track the unique wins.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. The list gives no venue, rules, or equipment details; find the named challenge in game and win it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. The trophy text does not specify which cabinet or game; finish a full game at any eligible arcade machine.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy’s final mission. The list does not name the mission or its unlock condition; follow Andy’s mission strand and verify its final objective in game.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton’s final mission. Follow Kenton’s mission strand to its last objective; the public description gives no location or order.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy’s final mission. Continue Billy’s mission strand until its final mission is marked complete; unlock details are not published.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish eight mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The list does not identify the strands, so record completed strands and continue until eight are credited.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy’s final mission by progressing through Randy’s mission strand. The trophy text gives no mission title or deadline.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone’s final mission by following Tyrone’s mission strand to its end. Any unlock prerequisites remain unconfirmed by the list.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. The public wording does not list the spots or their total; record each discovered meditation point as you find it.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. The list does not name the animal, habitat, or hunt steps; use Bret’s in-game request and its clues.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three Collectible Card sets. The description does not list card locations or set sizes; use the game’s set tracker and finish three full sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. The list does not explain the interaction or identify the locations; follow its in-game prompt and track each credited use.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The public wording does not enumerate challenge types; use the in-game challenge counter to see what qualifies and how many remain.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner, reach a four-star Wanted Level, then escape the heat. The trophy text does not specify a location or tactic; keep both partners together and lose the pursuit.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops back-to-back without losing the Wanted Level. The description supplies the sequence and constraint; exact shops and failure rules are not published.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The list does not define what counts as a discovery; use the in-game vehicle record and continue until it reaches 100.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during one use of Combat Focus. The five must fall in a single activation, so gather a suitable encounter and trigger the ability before defeating them.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. The wording does not explain what action qualifies; explore the airport and check the unlock after trying an unplanned exit.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The published text is only “Kinda hot in these Rhinos.” It does not state the action or threshold, so this guide cannot responsibly supply a method before release.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The list gives the stealth condition but no store or detection rules; plan around the game’s alerts and confirm the trigger in game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five Bank Vaults and escape. The list does not identify vaults or whether progress persists between attempts; record successful escapes and check the counter.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. The public description gives the required outcome but no spawn or getaway method; watch for the in-game opportunity and leave safely.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. No region list is included in the trophy text; use the game map and keep uncovering unexplored areas until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. The list does not name gangs or operations; note each gang’s credited operation and continue until all are represented.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The list names the beach and action but not a venue or exact viewpoint; try an eligible drink spot with the ocean in view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The wording does not define the required exit action; try the vehicle-through-showroom scenario and verify the unlock.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley. The description identifies the alley but not the exact interaction; visit it and complete the bowling action the game recognizes.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The phrase “A partnership with mass appeal” does not explain the required action. Check the trophy after partnership activities; a precise method is not supported by the list yet.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The description says “Choices made (for better or worse)” without naming a choice or threshold. Review story choices and check the trophy counter; details need in-game confirmation.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The description says “Second time’s the charm” but does not identify what must be retried. Attempt the relevant activity again and verify the unlock; a specific trigger is not published.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The description asks “What the hell just happened?” but does not identify the event. Keep exploring and check unusual encounters; no exact location can be confirmed from the list.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Use a melee attack during a drive-by to bowl someone over. The list does not describe controls; perform the melee drive-by action and confirm the target is knocked down.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. The amount and method are stated; use the contact laundering option and track the credited total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The list does not define shop categories or spending rules; track purchases in game and continue until the qualifying spend totals $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property. The public description gives no property list or total; use the property map and check off each garage purchase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The list does not explain registration steps; use that in-game app and confirm each vehicle is counted.
